convertibility_reason: VR Locker Lite is a position 'locker' utility, not a signal-based EA. It dynamically opens opposite-direction hedging positions to lock equity when profit thresholds are met. This requires tick-level monitoring of floating P&L per position, immediate hedging execution, and MT5-specific position management (PositionSelect, PositionGetDouble). The hedging/locking mechanism and tick-level P&L tracking are deeply MT5 platform-specific and cannot be meaningfully converted to a standalone Python signal strategy.

long.left: Floating profit of existing short position

short.left: Floating profit of existing long position

other_exits: Unlock logic: when locked pair's net profit reaches UnlockProfit threshold, both hedging position and original position (or the pair) are closed simultaneously to realize the locked equity gain

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lock volume equals the volume of the position being locked (mirrors the original position's lot size exactly to create a hedge)

custom_logic_notes: This is a locker/unlocker utility, not a directional trading EA. Core logic: (1) On each tick, scan all open positions for the current symbol. (2) If a position's floating profit >= LockProfit input, immediately open an opposite-direction position with equal volume to 'lock' the profit. (3) Track locked pairs (original + hedge). (4) If a locked pair's combined floating profit >= UnlockProfit input, close both positions simultaneously. (5) May include magic number filtering to only lock positions from specific EAs. (6) Requires hedging account (MT5 hedging mode). The entire purpose is equity protection via hedging, not signal-based entry.
python_conversion_notes: Not feasible as a signal-based strategy conversion. The EA is a risk management utility that operates on floating P&L monitoring and hedging position management. Python conversion would require: (1) a live position tracker with real-time P&L, (2) ability to open opposite hedging positions, (3) pair-tracking state machine for lock/unlock lifecycle, (4) broker API with hedging support. Recommend classifying as non-convertible risk management tool rather than generating signal-based Python code.
